ios.desc:
Transform Your Mindset, One Glance at a Time
How often do negative thoughts cloud your day? What if you could rewire your mind with powerful affirmations delivered exactly when you need them? Rebirth brings personalized inspiration, gratitude, and manifestation support right to your home screen - because transformation starts with the thoughts you choose to nurture.

Why Daily Affirmations Work

Affirmations are scientifically proven tools that strengthen the connection between your conscious and unconscious mind. By consistently exposing yourself to positive, empowering statements, you:

  • Rewire negative thought patterns and build lasting self-esteem
  • Create new neural pathways that support your goals and dreams
  • Strengthen resilience to face life's challenges with confidence
  • Shift from a scarcity mindset to one of abundance and possibility

  As you change your thoughts, you change your reality. Rebirth makes this transformation
  effortless and beautiful.

  Your Personal Growth Companion

  Choose from 22 carefully curated categories that speak to your unique journey:

  Personal Growth • Motivation • Self Confidence • Inner Peace • Resilience • Mindfulness • Self
  Love • Spiritual • Healing Relationship • Make Me Smile • Gratitude • Anxiety Relief •
  Creativity • Professional Growth • In Love • Productivity • One Day at a Time • Manifestation •
   Transformation • Healing Heartbreak • Physical Health • Body Positivity

  Select the categories that resonate with where you are and where you're going. Whether you're
  healing from heartbreak, building confidence, or manifesting your dreams - Rebirth meets you
  exactly where you are. And you can also add your own quotes to display both in app and in widget. 


  Beautiful Widgets That Inspire

  Your home screen is the first thing you see dozens of times a day. Make every glance count with
   Rebirth's stunning widgets:

  Customizable fonts - choose from 4 beautiful typography styles
  Category-based backgrounds—each category has its own inspiring imagery
  Time-of-day filtering—get morning motivation, afternoon energy, or evening reflection
  Instant shuffle—tap to get a new affirmation whenever you need fresh inspiration
  Auto-refresh—new affirmations appear throughout your day

  No need to open an app. Your inspiration is always there, beautifully displayed, impossible to
  miss.

  Privacy You Can Trust
